crossRefs.note: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds…
They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged…
He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from…
He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his…
and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”
Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you…

translations.web: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
translations.bsb: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens, and as officers for your tribes.
translations.kjv: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
translations.asv: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
